review_candidates.title: M&A Advisor
review_candidates.description: About Ecomswap Ecomswap is a boutique M&A advisory and acquisitions platform focused exclusively on high-performing Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), e-commerce, and digital brands across the US, EU, UK, and AUS. We partner with founders who have built real businesses and guide them through structured, high-value exits with qualified global buyers. Our environment is fast-moving, performance-driven and execution-focused. We value ownership, clarity, and measurable contribution. As we expand our on-site UAE team, we are looking for a polished and commercially minded M&A Advisor who understands digital businesses and thrives in a deal-led environment. This is not a typical 9-5 role. We operate across multiple time zones, and flexibility, accountability and professionalism are essential.   The Role This is a full-cycle, client-facing advisory role with direct ownership of DTC and e-commerce acquisition processes. You will manage deals end-to-end: understanding the seller’s business, shaping the investment narrative, engaging buyers, leading calls, managing diligence and driving transactions through to closing. You will act as the central point of coordination and trust between founders, buyers, and internal stakeholders - with ownership over deal direction. Success in this role requires strong financial judgment, structured communication, and the ability to remain calm and credible throughout complex deal processes.   Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for: Ownership of buyer relationships, engaging buyers with clarity, professionalism and timely follow-ups Analyzing financial statements, P&Ls, cash flow, and unit economics of DTC and e-commerce brands Building high-quality, narrative-driven Teaser Decks and investment materials Leading discovery and qualification calls with founders and buyers Managing structured Q&A processes between buyers and sellers Leading LOI drafting, negotiation, and alignment on commercial terms Coordinating due diligence across financial, operational, and marketing workstreams Overseeing APA preparation, escrow coordination, and closing documentation Maintaining deal accuracy and momentum, whilst maintaining high quality Representing Ecomswap with discretion, maturity, and strong commercial awareness   This role requires independence, ownership and the ability to manage multiple active deals without losing structure or quality.   Requirements We are looking for candidates who demonstrate: On-site availability in the UAE (mandatory) 3-7 years of experience in M&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Advisory, Investment Banking or Private Equity Strong financial modelling and analytical ability - comfortable independently assessing P&Ls Excellent written and verbal communication, with confidence in senior-level discussions Experience managing multiple client engagements or live deals simultaneously Strong writing ability for Teasers, summaries, and structured deal communication Professional presence, credibility, and relationship-building capability A genuine interest and long-term commitment to the M&A and acquisitions space A bonus if you have a solid understanding of DTC, e-commerce, SaaS, or digital business models We value initiative, intellectual curiosity, and individuals who take pride in high-quality execution.   What We Offer Competitive base salary with a strong, performance-linked bonus structure Exposure to high-quality, fast-moving DTC and digital brand transactions Full ownership of deal cycles and meaningful client relationships Clear growth path within a rapidly scaling advisory platform High-responsibility role with real impact on outcomes Supportive leadership and a structured operating environment   How to Apply Please submit your CV along with any relevant deal experience.

Our regional programs empower local talent, boost employment, and provide support for local agriculture, particularly through partnerships with farmers and suppliers. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace, one where every individual feels valued and empowered to be themselves. This commitment extends beyond our employees to positively impact the communities we serve, striving for shared growth and a healthier, more sustainable future for all. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment PepsiCo stands firmly behind our global commitment to diversity, equality, and human rights. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, ensuring a fair and welcoming workplace for all, regardless of age, gender, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. Our dedication to inclusion strengthens our workforce and helps drive our business forward, enriching both PepsiCo and the communities in North Africa. The Electrical Maintenance Engineer ensures the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of electrical equipment through preventive and corrective maintenance and effective troubleshooting of electrical and control systems. The role supports daily maintenance activities, leads the team, and ensures compliance with safety standards, technical procedures, and company policies. The position contributes to continuous improvement by implementing TPM, AIBI, EMS, and ERP systems, improving equipment performance, and managing energy consumption, spare parts, and maintenance costs. The engineer collaborates with internal departments and contractors, monitors KPIs, and develops team capabilities through coaching and technical training. Responsibilities Maintain the equipment within the required efficiency Applying maintenance procedures and ensuring people and equipment safety. Lead/support the working team administratively and technically on daily basis. Achieve and analyze maintenance key performance indicators and issue periodic follow-up reports. Troubleshooting different control problems (PLC, Drives ,…etc.) Aware of different electrical instrumentation devices. Achieve & follow-up the electricity, water and fuel consumption targets. Control the maintenance expenses daily. - Revise and sign on SPs (Spare Parts). Cooperate with purchasing department regarding any technical issues. Revise spare parts strategic items on annual basis. Revise the work orders completion with spare parts withdrawal and ensure that the replaced used parts are returned to the Store. Review and modify the spare parts item cards limit to ensure spare parts availability. Review and sign on to purchasing orders and technically approve supplier’s offers. Revise, check and approve imported spare parts orders. Technically inspect/accept new spare parts and receive on the system. Make sure that all workshop equipment is working properly. Participate in planning and preparation for projects. Follow up on contractors’ daily performance & onsite activities progress, ensuring quality & conformity to specifications. Annual revise for equipment fixed assists registry. Responsible for implementing PEMM (Pepsico Maintenance Methodology), AIBI (American Institute for Baking Industry Audit), TPM (Total Productive Maintenance), GEHSMS (Global EHS management system), QAS (Quality audit system), ERP (Employee Risk Protection) systems. Enhance equipment performance by updating the PM (preventive maintenance) programs. Raising-up team skills through internal technical training and coaching new team members. Follow up on the Proper execution of the TPM processes and ensure proper implementation of the required aspects in each step Supporting the team during the audits (PEMM, TPM, GEHSMS, AIB, QAS….) Qualifications Bachelor Engineering Graduate (Electrical department or any equivalent) (2-3) years of Experience in the maintenance field (Most preferred in the food industry Leadership skills. Communication & Presentation skills Write and speak English. Good computer skills. Time Management. Problems Analysis and solving
